title: Sounds with a shape
description: Three graphic record sleeves rotate through a compact, tactile collection.
useCase: Let a small music, print or editorial collection retain its physical character while making one item the focus.
interaction: Select a sleeve or browse with the arrow buttons
reducedMotion: Selection changes directly with no interpolated rotation or hover lift. Keyboard activation also skips transitions.
limitations: A deliberately small three-item collection; use a list or grid for large inventories. The preview does not play music or navigate to product pages.
look: Cream page with three fanned square record sleeves in red, cream and black, tight bold sans titles and geometric line art, plus outlined arrow buttons.
motion: Selecting a sleeve or pressing an arrow swings the three cards between front, right and left fan slots with a 280 ms expo ease-out; hovering lifts a cover 5 px.
adapt: Fan geometry is computed per card from `position` (`shift`, `angle`, `zIndex`) and animated by the `.sf-sleeves-card` transform transition (280 ms, `transform-origin:50% 130%`). Replace `records` and `SleeveArt` with your covers.
